versions.changelog:
v1.2.0 introduces 3 bold new visual styles for mind maps, bringing the total to 13 styles.

- Added editorial NYT-style, Bauhaus primary geometry, and Swiss Internationalist (Helvetica grid) styles.
- Three new styles have strong personality and pair well with designer-grade, visually distinctive scenarios.
- Visual systems of these new styles match those of huo15-flow-chart v1.4 for brand consistency.
- Expanded trigger keywords for style selection; see docs for full list.
- Updated aliases for improved usability.
- Added LICENSE file; removed obsolete skill-card.md.

## huo15-mind-map v1.1.1 Changelog

- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Version number update only; no new features or bug fixes.
v1.1.0: 新增 6 种预设风格（ocean 海洋蓝 / forest 森林绿 / sunset 夕阳暖橙 / minimal 极简素雅 / pastel 马卡龙粉嫩 / github 极客），合计 10 种；扩充中文别名。
